claims.paper_title: Article Composite Proton Exchange Membranes Based on Chitosan and Phosphotungstic Acid Immobilized One-Dimensional Attapulgite for Direct Methanol Fuel Cells
claims.quantitative_anchor: 35.3 mS cm⁻¹ at 80 °C (4 wt.% WQAT loading)
claims.claim_text: Attapulgite nanorods constrain phosphotungstic acid within high‑surface‑area domains, forming effective proton‑transport channels (proton conductivity 35.3 mS cm⁻¹ at 80 °C) (manual_1190463586).
Phosphate glasses provide a non‑crystalline, ionically conductive matrix that may remain mobile and avoid crystalline acid‑phase formation at low temperatures. (manual_3d7d6d5d7b)

claims.paper_title: Effect of deep eutectic solvent in proton conduction and thermal behaviour of chitosan-based membrane
claims.claim_text: Chitosan membrane with DES retains 49.4% water, suggesting bound‑water capacity that could support local mobility for proton conduction. (manual_42051140ac)

claims.paper_title: Effect of deep eutectic solvent in proton conduction and thermal behaviour of chitosan-based membrane
claims.claim_text: DES enhances water uptake (49.4% in chitosan blend) and proton conductivity, implying a role in retaining bound water. (manual_42051140ac)
Hydrogel electrolyte suppresses ice crystallisation and depresses the freezing point, maintaining continuous ionic conduction pathways at low temperatures. (manual_58ec9a6c2e)

claims.paper_title: Enhancing proton conductivity at subzero temperature through  constructing the well-ordered structure based on carbon dots
claims.claim_text: Carbon dots (CDs) enable a well-ordered dispersion that maintains a continuous proton-conduction pathway, yielding proton conductivity of 3.29 × 10⁻³ S cm⁻¹ at −30 °C (manual_89488460eb).

claims.paper_title: Phosphoric Acid-in-Clay Electrolyte Boosting Polybenzimidazole Membranes for High-Performance Fuel Cells
claims.claim_text: Halloysite nanotubes provide nanometric confinement for phosphoric acid, establishing a dense hydrogen-bonding network that facilitates ultrafast proton transport via packed-acid and Grotthuss mechanisms and improves acid retention (manual_a16330d0f5).

claims.paper_title: Enhanced Proton Conductivity from Phosphoric Acid-Incorporated 3D Polyacrylamide-Graft-Starch Hydrogel Materials for High-Temperature Proton Exchange Membranes
claims.claim_text: The 3D PAAm-g-starch hydrogel framework provides interconnected microporous space that absorbs and retains H3PO4 under pressure and anhydrous conditions, enabling high proton conductivity (manual_a624da98ce).

claims.paper_title: Enhanced Proton Conductivity by the Influence of Modified  Montmorillonite on Poly (Vinyl alcohol) Based Blend  Composite Membranes
claims.quantitative_anchor: 0.0802 S/cm at 6 wt% protonated MMT (temperature unspecified)
claims.claim_text: Montmorillonite clay at 6 wt% in a PVA/PEG blend provides enhanced proton conductivity of 0.0802 S/cm, attributed to nanometric dispersion creating interfacial proton transport pathways (manual_b9c3d1711d).

claims.paper_title: Preparation and properties of chitosan/organic-modified attapulgite composite proton exchange membranes for fuel cell applications
claims.claim_text: Chitosan provides a continuous, hydration-enabled proton-conduction pathway; the composite membrane with 2 wt% organic-modified attapulgite exhibits higher proton conductivity than pure chitosan film, indicating the matrix’s inherent proton transport capacity (manual_c0c1101384).

claims.paper_title: Preparation and properties of chitosan/organic-modified attapulgite composite proton exchange membranes for fuel cell applications
claims.claim_text: Organic-modified attapulgite introduces high-surface-area nanometric domains that confine proton-conducting electrolyte and suppress bulk crystallization, enhancing proton conductivity in chitosan-based composite membranes (manual_c0c1101384).
